name: hud_ui_message_box_dialog_constructor
description: HudUiMessageBoxDialog::Constructor builds the dialog layout, installs message-box button vtables, and creates the fallback solid-image layout when no ZRD path/section is provided.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf060 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and vtable data at 0x4bf060 validate the construction order, dialog/button vtable installation, primary-surface rectangle copy, ZRD binding path, and fallback dimensions/images/positions.

The native message-box constructor smoke verifies the null-ZRD fallback path: copied blit rectangle, 300x200 and 75x50 solid images, OK button image ownership fields, OK/Cancel button vtables, owner binding, visibility flags, and centered widget positions.
